subject: general
question: Who received the Padma Bhushan for Arts in the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajoy Chakravorty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2020, Ajoy Chakravorty** received the **Padma Bhushan for Arts**.
 
• **Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty** is a Patiala-Kasur Gharana Hindustani classical vocalist, composer, lyricist, and Gurudev.
 
• He is regarded as one of Indian classical music's legendary figures.
 
• He has also dominated several major Indian classical genres, including Delhi, Jaipur, Gwalior, Agra, Kirana, Rampur, and even South Indian Carnatic music.
 
• He has received the **Padma Shri (2011) and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (Delhi, 1999–2000), **as well as the National Film Award for Best Male Playback Singer in 1989 for the Bengali film "Chhandaneer." He was the first Indian classical performer to be invited to the Golden Jubilee Celebrations of India's Independence by Pakistan, China, and the BBC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Shashadhar Acharya **was awarded the Padma Shri honour by the Indian government in 2020 for his contributions to the arts.
 
• **Pandit Chhannulal Mishra** is a well-known Hindustani classical vocalist from Banaras, who is known for his work in the Kirana Gharana (school) of Hindustani classical music, particularly the Khayal and the 'Purab Ang' – Thumri.
 
• **Venu Srinivasan** is an Indian industrialist who was awarded the Padma Bhushan Award in January 2020, India's third-highest civilian honour.
